answers.core: It improves a core feature of the inspector in the editor.
answers.workaround: The closest "script" work around that I can think of is what I implemented in the end. Instead of having an Array that I would modify in the editor, I put each resource separately in the filesystem and wrote an editor script that I ran manually whenever I changed something to create a resource with the array programmatically. I think it's quite an onerous workaround because it requires people to learn about reading and creating resources programmatically, etc.

title: Better support for long arrays in the inspector, e.g. filter elements by string
